summary_1line: After Narada’s counsel, Rama preserves a dead brahmin child’s body and departs in the Pushpaka chariot to inspect his kingdom for wrongdoing.

image_candidates.scene_text: The golden Pushpaka chariot appears in the sky before Rama and bows as the armed prince prepares to ascend.
Rama, carrying bow, quivers, and shining sword, rises into the air in the Pushpaka chariot above Ayodhya.
Lakshmana orders the dead brahmin child’s body preserved in a jar of oil with fragrant unguents to prevent decay.
